title: PMP Limited - proposed acquisition of Times Printers Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: On 21 September 2007, PMP Limited, a publicly listed commercial printer announced that it had entered into an agreement to acquire 100% of the shares in Times Printers Australia Pty Ltd from Times Publishing Limited, a Singapore based printing and publishing company.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant market to be the national market for heat set web offset printing.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to lead to a significant increase in market concentration due to the presence of a number of other printers of similar or larger size.
